verses.geez: እቤ፡ አነ፡ በልብየ፡ ነዓ፡ እምክርከ፡ በፍሥሓ፡ ወርኢ፡ በሠናይ፡ ወናሁ፡ እቤ፡ ዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: I said in my heart, Come now, I will prove thee with mirth, and behold thou good: and, behold, this is also vanity.

translations.lxx: I said in my heart, Come now, I will prove thee with mirth, and behold thou good: and, behold, this is also vanity.
translations.kjv: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
translations.ron: Grăiam inimii mele: "Vino să te ispitesc cu veselia şi să te fac să guşti plăcerea!" Şi iată că şi aceasta este deşertăciune.
translations.grk: Εἶπον ἐγὼ ἐν καρδίᾳ μου, δεῦρο δὴ πειράσω σε ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, καὶ ἴδε ἐν ἀγαθῷ· καὶ ἰδοὺ καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης.

verses.geez: ለሰሐው፡ እብሎ፡ አስፍጦ፡ ወለፍሥሓ፡ ምንት፡ ውእቱዝ፡ ግብር።
verses.translation: I said to laughter, Madness: and to mirth, Why doest thou this?

translations.lxx: I said to laughter, Madness: and to mirth, Why doest thou this?
translations.kjv: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
translations.ron: "E nebunie!" am zis despre râs. Şi despre veselie: "La ce poate să folosească!"
translations.grk: Τῷ γέλωτι εἶπα, περιφορὰν, καὶ τῇ εὐφροσύνῃ, τί τοῦτο ποιεῖς;

verses.geez: ወመከርኩ፡ እምልብየ፡ ጥበብ፡ ሰሐበቶ፡ ከመ፡ ወይን፡ ለሥጋየ፡ ወልብየ፡ መሀረኒ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወዝኒ፡ እኂዝ፡ ለፍሥሓ፡ እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ እሬኢ፡ ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ ሠናይ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ሰበእ፡ ዘይገብሩ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ በኊልቈ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወቶሙ።
verses.translation: And I examined whether my heart would excite my flesh as with wine, (though my heart guided me in wisdom,) and I desired to lay hold of mirth, until I should see of what kind is the good to the sons of men, which they should do under the sun all the days of their life.

translations.lxx: And I examined whether my heart would excite my flesh as with wine, (though my heart guided me in wisdom,) and I desired to lay hold of mirth, until I should see of what kind is the good to the sons of men, which they should do under the sun all the days of their life.
translations.kjv: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
translations.ron: Am cugetat apoi în inima mea, să desfătez trupul meu cu vin - pe când cugetul meu umbla după înţelepciune şi cerceta nebunia - până ce voi vedea ceea ce este bun pentru fiii oamenilor să facă sub cer în vremea vieţii lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατεσκεψάμην εἰ ἡ καρδία μου ἑλκύσει ὡς οἶνον τὴν σάρκα μου, καὶ καρδία μου ὡδήγησεν ἐν σοφίᾳ, καὶ τοῦ κρατῆσαι ἐπʼ εὐφροσύνην, ἕως οὗ ἴδω ποῖον τὸ ἀγαθὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὃ ποιήσουσιν ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, ἀριθμὸν ἡμερῶν ζωῆς αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: አንሰ፡ መክብብ፡ አዕበይኩ፡ ምግባርየ፡ ወሐነጽኩ፡ ሊተ፡ አብያተ፡ ወተከልኩ፡ አዕፃዳተ፡ ወይን።
verses.translation: I enlarged my work; I built me houses; I planted me vineyards.

translations.lxx: I enlarged my work; I built me houses; I planted me vineyards.
translations.kjv: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
translations.ron: Am început lucrări mari: am zidit case, am sădit vii,
translations.grk: Ἐμεγάλυνα ποίημἀ μου, ᾠκοδόμησά μοι οἴκους, ἐφύτευσά μοι ἀμπελῶνας,

verses.geez: ወገበርኩ፡ ሊተ፡ አዕፃዳተ፡ ሐምል፡ ወገነታተ፡ ወተከልኩ፡ ውስቴቶሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ዘይፈርዩ፡ በበዖታሆሙ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘኢይፈሪ።
verses.translation: I made me gardens and orchards, and planted in them every kind of fruit-tree.

translations.lxx: I made me gardens and orchards, and planted in them every kind of fruit-tree.
translations.kjv: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
translations.ron: Am făcut grădini şi parcuri şi am sădit în ele tot felul de pomi roditori;
translations.grk: ἐποίησά μοι κήπους καὶ παραδείσους, καὶ ἐφύτευσα ἐν αὐτοῖς ξύλον πᾶν καρποῦ.

verses.geez: ወገበርኩ፡ ሊተ፡ ምዕቃለ፡ ማያት፡ ከመ፡ እሥቂ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ኦመ፡ ወዕፀ፡ ዘይፈሪ፡ ገራህተ፡ ወገራውህ፡ አጥረይኩ።
verses.translation: I made me pools of water, to water from them the timber-bearing wood.

translations.lxx: I made me pools of water, to water from them the timber-bearing wood.
translations.kjv: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
translations.ron: Mi-am făcut iazuri, ca să pot uda din ele o dumbravă unde creşteau copacii;
translations.grk: Ἐποίησά μοι κολυμβήθρας ὑδάτων τοῦ ποτίσαι ἀπʼ αὐτῶν δρυμὸν βλαστῶντα ξύλα.

verses.geez: አግብርተ፡ ወአእማተ፡ ወልደ፡ ቤት፡ አጥረይኩ፡ ጥሪተ፡ ወኖሎተ፡ አልሕምት፡ ወመራዕየ፡ አባግዕ፡ ብዙኀ፡ አጥረይኩ፡ እምኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ኮኑ፡ እምቅድሜየ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም።
verses.translation: I got servants and maidens, and servants were born to me in the house: also I had abundant possession of flocks and herds, beyond all who were before me in Jerusalem.

translations.lxx: I got servants and maidens, and servants were born to me in the house: also I had abundant possession of flocks and herds, beyond all who were before me in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
translations.ron: Am cumpărat robi şi roabe şi am avut feciori născuţi în casă, asemenea şi turme de vite, şi oi fără de număr, mai mult decât toţi cei care au fost înaintea mea în Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Ἐκτησάμην δούλους καὶ παιδίσκας, καὶ οἰκογενεῖς ἐγένοντό μοι, καί γε κτῆσις βουκολίου καὶ ποιμνίου πολλὴ ἐγένετό μοι ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς γενομένους ἔμπροσθέν μου ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.geez: ወአስተጋባእኩ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ብሩረ፡ ወወርቀ፡ ወጥሪተ፡ መንግሥት፡ ወበሐውርተ፡ ኀለይተ፡ ወኀላይያነ፡ ወፍግዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: Moreover I collected for myself both silver and gold also, and the peculiar treasures of kings and provinces: I procured me singing men and singing women, and delights of the sons of men, a butler and female cupbearers.

translations.lxx: Moreover I collected for myself both silver and gold also, and the peculiar treasures of kings and provinces: I procured me singing men and singing women, and delights of the sons of men, a butler and female cupbearers.
translations.kjv: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
translations.ron: Am strâns aur şi argint şi număr mare de regi şi de satrapi; am adus cântăreţi şi cântăreţe şi desfătarea fiilor anului mi-am agonisit: o prinţesă şi alte prinţese.
translations.grk: Συνήγαγόν μοι καί γε ἀργύριον καί γε χρυσίον, καὶ περιουσιασμοὺς βασιλέων καὶ τῶν χωρῶν· ἐποίησά μοι ᾄδοντας καὶ ᾀδούσας, καὶ ἐντρυφήματα υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων, οἰνοχόον καὶ οἰνοχόας.

verses.geez: መዘርተ፡ ወመዛርያነ፡ አዕበይኩ፡ ወአፈድፈድኩ፡ እምእለ፡ ኮኑ፡ እምቅድሜየ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወጥበብየኒ፡ ቆመተኒ።
verses.translation: So I became great, and advanced beyond all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom was established to me.

translations.lxx: So I became great, and advanced beyond all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom was established to me.
translations.kjv: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
translations.ron: Am fost mare şi am întrecut pe toţi cei ce au trăit înaintea mea în Ierusalim şi înţelepciunea a rămas cu mine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμεγαλύνθην καὶ προσέθηκα παρὰ πάντας τοὺς γενομένους ἀπὸ ἔμπροσθέν μου ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ, καί γε σοφία μου ἐστάθη μοι.

verses.geez: ኵሎ፡ ዘሰአላ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ኢተመቈስኩ፡ ወኢከላእክዎ፡ ለልብየ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ እስመ፡ ልብየ፡ ተፈሥሐ፡ በኵሉ፡ ፃማየ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ኮነ፡ መክፈልትየ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሥራኅየ።
verses.translation: And whatever mine eyes desired, I withheld not from them, I withheld not my heart from all my mirth: for my heart rejoiced in all my labour; and this was my portion of all my labour.

translations.lxx: And whatever mine eyes desired, I withheld not from them, I withheld not my heart from all my mirth: for my heart rejoiced in all my labour; and this was my portion of all my labour.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
translations.ron: Şi tot ceea ce doreau ochii mei nu am dat la o parte şi n-am oprit inima mea de la nici o veselie, căci inima mea s-a bucurat de toată osteneala mea, şi aceasta mi-a fost partea din toată munca mea.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶν ὃ ᾔτησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου, οὐκ ἀφεῖλον ἀπʼ αὐτῶν· οὐκ ἀπεκώλυσα τὴν καρδίαν μου ἀπὸ πάσης εὐφροσύνης μου, ὅτι καρδία μου εὐφράνθη ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ μου· καὶ τοῦτο ἐγένετο μερίς μου ἀπὸ παντὸς μόχθου μου.

verses.geez: ወነፀርኩ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ጥሪትየ፡ ዘገብራ፡ እደውየ፡ ወበሥራኅየ፡ ዘሠራዕኩ፡ ለገቢር፡ ወናሁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ፍድፋዴ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: And I looked on all my works which my hands had wrought, and on my labour which I laboured to perform: and, behold, all was vanity and waywardness of spirit, and there is no advantage under the sun.

translations.lxx: And I looked on all my works which my hands had wrought, and on my labour which I laboured to perform: and, behold, all was vanity and waywardness of spirit, and there is no advantage under the sun.
translations.kjv: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
translations.ron: Apoi m-am uitat cu luare aminte la toate lucrurile pe care le-au făcut mâinile mele şi la truda cu care m-am trudit ca să le săvârşesc şi iată, totul este deşertăciune şi vânare de vânt şi fără nici un folos sub soare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέβλεψα ἐγὼ ἐν πᾶσι ποιήμασί μου οἷς ἐποίησαν αἱ χεῖρές μου, καὶ ἐν μόχθῳ ᾧ ἐμόχθησα τοῦ ποιεῖν, καὶ ἰδοὺ τὰ πάντα ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι περίσσεια ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.geez: ወነፀርኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ እርአይ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወተሰፍጦ፡ ወዕበደ፡ መኑ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይተሉ፡ ድኅሬሃ፡ ለምክር፡ ወኵሎ፡ ምሳሌ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ላቲ።
verses.translation: Then I looked on to see wisdom, and madness, and folly: for who is the man who will follow after counsel, in all things wherein he employs it?

translations.lxx: Then I looked on to see wisdom, and madness, and folly: for who is the man who will follow after counsel, in all things wherein he employs it?
translations.kjv: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
translations.ron: Şi mi-am întors privirea să văd înţelepciunea, nebunia şi prostia. Căci ce poate să facă un om de rând peste ceea ce a făcut un rege?
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέβλεψα ἐγὼ τοῦ ἰδεῖν σοφίαν καὶ παραφορὰν καὶ ἀφροσύνην, ὅτι τίς ἄνθρωπος ὅς ἐπελεύσεται ὀπίσω τῆς βουλῆς; τὰ ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወርኢኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመቦ፡ ፍድፍድና፡ ለጠቢብ፡ እምዐብድ፡ ከመ፡ ፍድፋዴ፡ ብርሃን፡ እምጽልመት።
verses.translation: And I saw that wisdom excels folly, as much as light excels darkness.

translations.lxx: And I saw that wisdom excels folly, as much as light excels darkness.
translations.kjv: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
translations.ron: Atunci m-am încredinţat că înţelepciunea are întâietate asupra nebuniei tot atât cât are lumina asupra întunericului.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδον ἐγὼ ὅτι ἐστὶ περίσσεια τῇ σοφίᾳ ὑπὲρ τὴν ἀφροσύνην, ὡς περίσσεια τοῦ φωτὸς ὑπὲρ τὸ σκότος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለጠቢብ፡ ዐዕይንቲሁ፡ ዲበ፡ ርእሱ፡ ወዐብድሰ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ የሐውር፡ ወአእመርኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ አሐዱ፡ ድድቅ፡ ይዳደቆሙ፡ ለክልኤሆሙ።
verses.translation: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walks in darkness: and I perceived, even I, that one event shall happen to them all.

translations.lxx: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walks in darkness: and I perceived, even I, that one event shall happen to them all.
translations.kjv: The wise man’s eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
translations.ron: Înţeleptul are ochii în cap, iar nebunul merge întru întuneric. Dar am cunoscut şi eu că aceeaşi soartă vor avea toţi.
translations.grk: Τοῦ σοφοῦ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν κεφαλῇ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὁ ἄφρων ἐν σκότει πορεύεται· καὶ ἔγνων καί γε ἐγὼ, ὅτι συνάντημα ἓν συναντήσεται τοῖς πᾶσιν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወሶቤሃ፡ አነ፡ እቤ፡ በልብየ፡ በከመ፡ ይዳደቆ፡ ለዐብድ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሊተኒ፡ ይዳደቀኒ፡ ወለምንት፡ ጠበብኩ፡ አነ፡ አሜሃ፡ በከ፡ አፈድፈድኩ፡ ነቢበ፡ እስመ፡ ዝኒ፡ ከንቱ።
verses.translation: And I said in my heart, As the event of the fool is, so shall it be to me, even to me; and to what purpose have I gained wisdom? I said moreover in my heart, This is also vanity, because the fool speaks of his abundance.

translations.lxx: And I said in my heart, As the event of the fool is, so shall it be to me, even to me; and to what purpose have I gained wisdom? I said moreover in my heart, This is also vanity, because the fool speaks of his abundance.
translations.kjv: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
translations.ron: Deci am zis în inima mea: "Aceeaşi soartă ca şi cel nebun avea-voi şi eu; atunci la ce îmi foloseşte înţelepciunea?" Şi am zis în mintea mea că şi aceasta este deşertăciune.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπα ἐγὼ ἐν καρδίᾳ μου, ὡς συνάντημα τοῦ ἄφρονος καί γε ἐμοὶ συναντήσεταί μοι, καὶ ἱνατί ἐσοφισάμην ἐγώ; περισσὸν ἐλάλησα ἐν καρδίᾳ μου, ὅτι καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης, διότι ὁ ἄφρων ἐκ περισσεύματος λαλεῖ·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዝክር፡ ለጠቢብ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐብድ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ ናሁ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይመጽእ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ይትረሳዕ፡ ወእፎ፡ ይመውት፡ ጠቢብ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐብድ።
verses.translation: For there is no remembrance of the wise man with the fool for ever; forasmuch as now in the coming days all things are forgotten: and how shall the wise man die with the fool?

translations.lxx: For there is no remembrance of the wise man with the fool for ever; forasmuch as now in the coming days all things are forgotten: and how shall the wise man die with the fool?
translations.kjv: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
translations.ron: Căci pomenirea celui înţelept ca şi a celui nebun nu este veşnică, fiindcă în zilele ce vor veni amândoi vor fi uitaţi; atunci înţeleptul moare ca şi nebunul.
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ μνήμη τοῦ σοφοῦ μετὰ τοῦ ἄφρονος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καθότι ἤδη αἱ ἡμέραι ἐρχόμεναι τὰ πάντα ἐπελήσθη· καὶ πῶς ἀποθανεῖται ὁ σοφὸς μετὰ τοῦ ἄφρονος;

verses.geez: ወጸላእኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ህይወትየ፡ እስመ፡ እምእኩይ፡ ፍጥረት፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: So I hated life; because the work that was wrought under the sun was evil before me: for all is vanity and waywardness of spirit.

translations.lxx: So I hated life; because the work that was wrought under the sun was evil before me: for all is vanity and waywardness of spirit.
translations.kjv: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.ron: Drept aceea am urât viaţa, căci rele sunt cele ce se fac sub soare; şi totul este deşertăciune şi vânare de vânt.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμίσησα σὺν τὴν ζωήν· ὅτι πονηρὸν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὸ ποίημα τὸ πεποιημένον ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, ὅτι πάντα ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος.

verses.geez: ጸላእኩ፡ አነ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥራኅየ፡ ዘአነ፡ እሠርኅ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ እስመ፡ አኀድጎ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ዘይትወለድ፡ እምድኅሬየ።
verses.translation: And I hated the whole of my labour which I took under the sun; because I must leave it to the man who will come after me.

translations.lxx: And I hated the whole of my labour which I took under the sun; because I must leave it to the man who will come after me.
translations.kjv: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
translations.ron: Şi am urât toată munca pe care am muncit-o sub soare, fiindcă voi lăsa-o omului care va veni după mine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμίσησα ἐγὼ σύμπαντα μόχθον μου ὃν ἐγὼ κοπιῶ ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον, ὅτι ἀφίω αὐτὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ γινομένῳ μετʼ ἐμέ.

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ የአምር፡ እመ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ይከውን፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ዐብድ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ይሤለጥ፡ በኵሉ፡ ዘሥራኅየ፡ ዘሠራኅኩ፡ ወተጠበብኩ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: And who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? and whether he will have power over all my labour in which I laboured, and wherein I grew wise under the sun? this is also vanity.

translations.lxx: And who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? and whether he will have power over all my labour in which I laboured, and wherein I grew wise under the sun? this is also vanity.
translations.kjv: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
translations.ron: Şi cine ştie dacă el va fi înţelept sau nebun! Şi el va face ce va găsi cu cale din tot lucrul cu care m-am trudit şi m-am chibzuit sub soare! Şi aceasta este deşertăciune!
translations.grk: Καὶ τίς εἶδεν εἰ σοφὸς ἔσται ἢ ἄφρων; καὶ εἰ ἐξουσιάζεται ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ μου, ᾧ ἐμόχθησα καὶ ᾧ ἐσοφισάμην ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον; καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης.

verses.geez: ወተመየጥኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ እትዋገዞ፡ ለልብየ፡ በኵሉ፡ ሥራኅየ፡ ዘሠራኅኩ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: So I went about to dismiss from my heart all my labour wherein I had laboured under the sun.

translations.lxx: So I went about to dismiss from my heart all my labour wherein I had laboured under the sun.
translations.kjv: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
translations.ron: Şi am început să mă las deznădejdii pentru toată munca cea de sub soare,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα ἐγὼ τοῦ ἀποτάξασθαι τὴν καρδίαν μου ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ μου ᾧ ἐμόχθησα ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቦ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይሠርኅ፡ ሎቱ፡ በጥበብ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ በጽኑዕ፡ ወበምክር፡ ወለብእሲ፡ ዘኢሠርኀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይሁብ፡ መክፈልቶ፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወእኩይ፡ ዓቢይ።
verses.translation: For there is such a man that his labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in fortitude; yet this man shall give his portion to one who has not laboured therein. This is also vanity and great evil.

translations.lxx: For there is such a man that his labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in fortitude; yet this man shall give his portion to one who has not laboured therein. This is also vanity and great evil.
translations.kjv: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
translations.ron: Căci un om care a pus în lucrul lui înţelepciune şi ştiinţă şi a avut izbândă, îl împarte cu cel care n-a lucrat. Şi aceasta aste deşertăciune şi un rău nespus de mare.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐστὶν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μόχθος αὐτοῦ ἐν σοφίᾳ καὶ ἐν γνώσει καὶ ἐν ἀνδρίᾳ· καὶ ἄνθρωπος ᾧ οὐκ ἐμόχθησεν ἐν αὐτῷ, δώσει αὐτῷ μερίδα αὐτοῦ· καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ πονηρία μεγάλη.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢይከውኖ፡ ለብእሲ፡ በኵሉ፡ ፃማሁ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ ልቡ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ይሠርኅ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: For it happens to a man in all his labour, and in the purpose of his heart wherein he labours under the sun.

translations.lxx: For it happens to a man in all his labour, and in the purpose of his heart wherein he labours under the sun.
translations.kjv: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
translations.ron: Oare, ce-i rămâne omului din toată munca lui şi din grija inimii lui cu care s-a trudit sub soare?
translations.grk: ὅτι γίνεται ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν προαιρέσει καρδίας αὐτοῦ ᾧ αὐτὸς μοχθεῖ ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ ሕማም፡ ወመዓት፡ ወንታፌ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወበሌሊትኒ፡ ኢይነውም፡ ልቡ፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
verses.translation: For all his days are days of sorrows, and vexation of spirit is his; in the night also his heart rests not. This is also vanity.

translations.lxx: For all his days are days of sorrows, and vexation of spirit is his; in the night also his heart rests not. This is also vanity.
translations.kjv: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
translations.ron: Toate zilele lui nu sunt decât suferinţă şi îndeletnicirea lui nu-i decât necaz; nici chiar noaptea n-are odihnă inima lui. Şi aceasta este deşertăciune!
translations.grk: Ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ἀλγημάτων καὶ θυμοῦ περισπασμὸς αὐτοῦ, καί γε ἐν νυκτὶ οὐ κοιμᾶται ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ· καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης ἐστίν.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ሠናይ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዘበልዐ፡ ወሰትየ፡ ወዘያሬእያ፡ ሠናየ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ወዝኒ፡ ዘርኢኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ እምእደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: A man has nothing really good to eat, and to drink, and to shew his soul as good in his trouble. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

translations.lxx: A man has nothing really good to eat, and to drink, and to shew his soul as good in his trouble. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
translations.kjv: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
translations.ron: Nimic nu este mai bun pentru om decât să mănânce şi să bea şi să-şi desfăteze sufletul cu mulţumirea din munca sa. Şi am văzut că şi aceasta vine numai din mâna lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔστιν ἀγαθὸν ἀνθρώπῳ, ὃ φάγεται καὶ ὃ πίεται καὶ ὃ δείξει τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ ἀγαθὸν ἐν μόχθῳ αὐτοῦ· καί γε τοῦτο εἶδον ἐγὼ ὅτι ἀπὸ χειρὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν·

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይበልዕ፡ ወይሰቲ፡ ዘእንበሌሁ።
verses.translation: For who shall eat, or who shall drink, without him?

translations.lxx: For who shall eat, or who shall drink, without him?
translations.kjv: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
translations.ron: Cine poate oare să mănânce şi să bea fără să mulţumească Lui?
translations.grk: Ὅτι τίς φάγεται καὶ τίς πίεται πάρεξ αὐτοῦ;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ኄር፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ወሀቦ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ወፍሥሐ።
verses.translation: For God has given to the man who is good in his sight, wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but he has given to the sinner trouble, to add and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God; for this is also vanity and waywardness of spirit.

translations.lxx: For God has given to the man who is good in his sight, wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but he has given to the sinner trouble, to add and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God; for this is also vanity and waywardness of spirit.
translations.kjv: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.ron: Omului care este bun înaintea lui Dumnezeu, Dumnezeu îi dă înţelepciune, ştiinţă şi bucurie, iar păcătosului îi dă sarcina să adune şi să strângă pentru a da celui ce este bun în faţa lui Dumnezeu. Şi aceasta este deşertăciune şi vinare de vânt!
translations.grk: Ὅτι τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ ἀγαθῷ πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἔδωκε σοφίαν καὶ γνῶσιν καὶ εὐφροσύνην, καὶ τῷ ἁμαρτάνοντι ἔδωκε περισπασμὸν τοῦ προσθεῖναι καὶ τοῦ συναγαγεῖν, τοῦ δοῦναι τῷ ἀγαθῷ πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅτι καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος.

verses.geez: ወለዘሰ፡ ይኤብስ፡ ወሀቦ፡ ሥራኀ፡ ከመ፡ ይወስክ፡ ወያስተጋብእ፡ ብዕለ፡ ከመ፡ የሀብ፡ ለኄር፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወዝኒ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወፍትወተ፡ መንፈስ።
